rule.origin: GELB A-G427, from a defect I found in their record
rule.statement: a citation names what a document CARRIES — a quoted sentence, a pin id, a section — and a line number may accompany it but never replace it.
rule.asymmetry: a quoted sentence that moves is still findable; a line number that moves is silently wrong with nothing to signal it.

finding:
A-G427 ON MY OWN RECORD: 86 line-number citations across 47 scanned files (this audit's own source EXCLUDED — its first form counted its own header's examples, A-G408), after classifying 6 port/address numbers OUT — a bare grep counted those as citations and would have inflated my denominator in the direction that makes my record look worse, which is the same error GELB's first verifier made in the same direction.
69 of 86 (80.2 %) carry a SUBJECT on the same line — a quoted sentence, a pin id, a section or a filename — so they survive A-G427 with the number as an accompaniment rather than as the citation. 17 carry an offset and nothing else, and those are unverifiable permanently, not weakly: the record does not say what they were meant to name.
INTO THE PRODUCT COMPONENT, the one cited target this lane EDITS: 8 citations, of which 1 now land on a blank or brace-only line. §93 shifted that file by +7 and I reported GELB's stale citations in the same phase.
NO VERDICT (A-G36 point 2): this counts and classifies. It accuses nobody, including me — zero verified would be a finding that needs no accusation.
